description:
1. Run `python3 /workspace/scripts/sync_feishu_contacts.py /workspace/openclaw.json consultancy_bot_v2 /workspace/USER.md` (or using ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json) to populate the contact table. This must produce the Chinese-header table '## 飞书通讯录 (consultancy_bot_v2)' with '| 姓名 | open_id |' headers and the explanatory text about chat_id format `user:ou_xxx` in USER.md.
2. Add the Chinese-language sender identification snippet to AGENTS.md — must reference extracting open_id from `user:ou_xxx` format, warn not to assume DM sender is the primary human, and note that group messages carry Sender metadata.
3. Add group chat etiquette rules to AGENTS.md or SOUL.md: respond only when @mentioned or can add value, stay silent for casual banter, one reaction per message, don't monologue, keep replies concise.
4. Add Feishu platform formatting rules: NO markdown (no **bold**, no # headers, no [links](url)), NO tables, plain text with line breaks only, code blocks sparingly allowed.
5. Add multi-user privacy rules: conversations between different users are isolated, never reveal what user A said to user B, each DM is a private space.
6. Add DM behavior rules: always address sender by their looked-up name, never assume DM is from the 'primary human' — anyone can message.
7. Set up a weekly crontab entry with the EXACT schedule `0 7 * * 1` (Monday 7am) running the sync script with the correct three-argument signature pointing to the openclaw config, feishu account name, and USER.md path.
